description.raw:
'''Innate:''' After casting an [[File:Champion ability.svg|20px|link=Champion ability|An icon representing the keyword Champion ability]] [[:Champion ability|ability]], '''Lee Sin's''' next 2 [[File:Basic attack cursor icon.png|20px|link=Basic attack|An icon representing the keyword Basic attack]] [[:Basic attack|basic attacks]] [[File:On-hit icon.png|20px|link=Attack_effects#On_Hitting|An icon representing the keyword On-hit]] [[:Attack_effects#On_Hitting|on-hit]] within 3 seconds gain [[File:Attack speed icon.png|15px|link=Attack speed]] 40% '''bonus''' attack speed and restore [[File:Energy icon.svg|15px|link=Energy]] energy.

The first attack restores 20 / 30 / 40 (based on level) energy and the second attack restores「 10 / 15 / 20 (based on level) energy. 」「 half of the previous amount. 」
description.text:
Innate: After casting an ability, Lee Sin's next 2 basic attacks on-hit within 3 seconds gain  40% bonus attack speed and restore  energy.
The first attack restores 20 / 30 / 40 (based on level) energy and the second attack restores「 10 / 15 / 20 (based on level) energy. 」「 half of the previous amount. 」
